title: Keep GameCove off the game's cores
line: While a game runs, GameCove's own work moves to the efficiency cores at low priority.
symptom: GameCove's background work could land on a performance core next to the game's render thread.
risk_note: Only moves GameCove's own process; no system file changes.

changes.detail: While a game runs: CPU affinity to the efficiency cores and nice 10 (taskset, renice). Nothing is written to disk.

undo: Affinity and priority go back when the game ends, or at once when you switch it off.
sources: ClawDeck py_modules/clawdeck/quiet.py (same author, measured on the Claw 8 EX 2026-11-04)

probe.what: GameCove's own behaviour: there is nothing upstream to wait for.
